entities.name: Muhamed Filipović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muhamed Filipović was a Bosnian academic, writer, essayist, theorist and philosopher. As a young man he took part in the communist takeover of power and Yugoslav Partisans in 1945. He worked as a professor at the Faculty of Humanities at the University of Sarajevo.
